title: This GitHub Skill Auto-Builds a Beautiful README With AI
description:
A GitHub skill can now turn any repo into a slick project page on its own 🔥 It reads you code, figures out what the project does, then builds a unique SVG header. Best part, the design and colors are pulled from your actual project every time, so no generic template. Works with Codex and other agents, one command to install ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
